messages:
cheng: Morning all — proposing a scaled-bounceback blue/green shift for router pool eu-west1 at 09:30 UTC. 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 20m windows.
maria: 👍 what's the quiet/change window for support and product?
alex: 09:30 UTC ok for infra. Are we preserving session affinity or swapping cookies?
cheng: We'll keep cookie-based session stickiness for 30m after traffic moves. header X-RW-Route will mark green.
jo: Capacity check: edge-pool-beta has warm nodes. Current spare capacity 18% p95. I can bump 2 nodes pre-shift if needed.
sre-oncall: Set rollback thresholds: p95 latency +40% over baseline OR error-rate spike >1.5x sustained for 2m => immediate pause + rollback.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks commencing: nginx config sync ok, certs valid, health checks passing (3/3).
ops-runner: Quick snippet for the tilt command if you need it: ```bash
rwctl router shift --pool eu-west1 --from blue --to green --stages 10,30,60,100 --window 1200
```
maria: Pingting infra team: @jo @alex plz watch first step; support will open a banner at 09:25. Release notes uploaded: https://confluence.redwood/release/rls-2026-03-bounceback (includes rollback playbook).
alex: Confirming we will pin the new router binary to v2.4.1 across green nodes before shift?
jo: Yes, green pool already running v2.4.1 and health probes are stable.
cheng: Rolling target: green nodes pinned to v2.4.1. If we hit issue on 30% -> we'll stop and run canary-diagnostic script.
sre-oncall: Add tracing flag on the router for the shift: ?trace=shift-1758504321 so we can correlate traces. Also enable 1m burn-in alerts on datadog.
deploy-bot: Canary probes: synthetic requests ok (latency 55ms). Starting shift in 5m.
maria: Support banner set. Notifying PMs.
ops-runner: One more: route-weight command if we need manual rollback: ```bash
rwctl router set-weight --pool eu-west1 --green 0 --blue 100
```
cheng: Decision criteria: if p95 > threshold or error burst -> manual rollback. If minor uptick (<20% latency) -> hold and watch for next window.
alex: We'll watch KV cache hit ratio too — if it drops below 80% after 30% step, escalate.
deploy-bot: SHIFT STARTED: 10% -> 30% step scheduled.
maria: :eyes: watching support channel.
sre-oncall: Observability: dashboards pinned -> /dashboards/router-eu-west, logs filtered on trace=shift-1758504321.
deploy-bot: STEP SUCCESS: 30% stable for 5m. Proceeding to 60% in 2m.
jo: Bumped 2 warm nodes as planned. No capacity alarms.
cheng: moving to 60% now.
deploy-bot: STEP SUCCESS: 60% stable 6m. Advancing to 100%.
alex: KV hit at 83% after 60% so good.
sre-oncall: No error spike. p95 within +12%. Proceed.
deploy-bot: FINAL STEP SUCCESS: green at 100%. Router tilt complete.
maria: Released notes finalized. Closing change window at 10:05 UTC. Thanks team. :tada:
cheng: Great job everyone. We'll keep tracing for 2h and close incident if nothing anomalous.
notes: planning thread, preflight + live shift updates, successful completion, rollback thresholds defined
